subject: Fiscal 2027 Joint Budget Update
overview: The City Council and School Committee convened in a joint session to review the FY 2027 budget calendar and receive a preliminary financial update from the administration. Officials discussed revenue projections, cost drivers, and funding baselines for Medford Public Schools.

items.title: Paper 26-061: FY 2027 Budget Schedule
items.summary: Council President Zac Bears reviewed the council's proposed schedule for FY 2027 budget reviews and department hearings, and School Committee Acting Chair Paul Ruseau summarized the school district's budget formulation process.

items.title: Administration Financial Update and Budget Outlook
items.summary: CFO Bob Dickinson delivered a financial update outlining revenue trends, cost increases for health insurance and pensions, and an initial projected municipal deficit between $1 million and $1.8 million. Committee members and councilors questioned the administration on local receipt estimates, the expiration of ARPA funding, and differing interpretations of how the 2024 override stabilization funds apply to the school district's base budget.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: No members of the public rose to speak on the presentation.
